reaction.text: Ooh, this is an original take, I'm thinking about when the Millenium falcon is chased by TIE fighters. Or when Obi-Wan (is it?) is chased by two heat-seeking missiles (by boba fett?) and he spins to make them collide with each other.
Maybe A bit samey, but I like the flow feeling.
Felt slow to start over. Felt like I had improved. Felt lame whenever there was a single enemy left. I want the high-octane moments.
I actually feel like there is potential, If we would change the meta loop a bit. But the concept has huge potential. Did we invent this? I've never seen it before.

I like the tempo and the intensity. Would be cool to have something to achieve as well that forces me to try to move into certain areas. Like something I need to pick up before time runs out in some way maybe. Like objectives that I can plan for, not timed pickups that appear randomly.

Weird that "shift" was the key before and now it's "e". But I like the freshness of a new mechanism! Another window popped up and stole focus, that's why I died so early. That has nothing to do with this game.

A bit overwhelmed with so many actions now. I was focusing on them and died. Kind of takes away from the flow. The Decoy one seems a bit much. The movement + dash seemed like a great balance of cognitive load.
I loved the initial intensity. I did not see the exit actually.

It was very intense. Felt good to narrowly escape! Maybe a bit static that the exit was just there and building up, it felt a bit unexplained and forced. Maybe if I would have to pick up keys or something to unlock it would have made more sense and forced me to go to other areas. The cadence was always pretty max so it felt less dynamic than before. But I learned to focus on getting away instead of getting fancy. I guess that is both good and bad, because getting fancy and setting up traps for the enemies made me feel clever. But now there was no time for that, I just had to escape and all dead enemies were mostly accidental. I couldn't plan it at all. So actually that's a bit of a problem.

Ok, if I disregard the shift dash it's actually more fun. That one stresses me out because I feel like I need to use it. Movement only is best so far. Also, as I learn I actually like this more and more I think.

Yeah I'm actually thinking three keys spread out that would open the exit would be great. And each with a dotted line or something toward the exit, that would clearly show the connection and serve as the onboarding and the reminder. I'm starting to love this. Also, I enjoyed the neutral obstacles a lot, especially when they where moving in arena 5.

Actually it's probably a bit too easy with three hearts. I'm thinking second touch should kill me, and when I can set the pace with keys myself it will mostly be shorter levels I think which is cool. My favorite moment I think was dodging between the moving obstacles and watching chasers smash into them. I realize that's probably because that is just like being chased by tie fighters in an asteroid field. But I'm thinking the moving obstacles should probably be dangerous to me as well, because it feels a bit unfair now that I can like hug them while they kill my opponents.
Wow that was fast. I kind of like it though. We might need more levels. I'll have to try again.
It's actually too little dodging between asteroids, which was my favorite movement. It's just get in get out.

I'm thinking maybe it should be a side scroller with asteroids and chasers. Let me try that! I can still move across the whole screen but it also scrolls so i make progress. And when I reach the end I win.

The asteroid field seems off, and the auto-scrolling as well. It seems like everyone have a weird gravity towards the right. Also, the asteroids are static which is boring. I want them to be flying about like asteroids. I'm thinking maybe we stop the auto-scrolling and instead force the player to go right by having a death wave rolling from the right. Would that fix the weird gravity feeling?
Woah, trying to navigate and got killed immediately. Probably ease off in the beginning to let me find my bearings.
Ooh, I like that the chasers are faster than me! But they turn slower, so I need to do some clever dodging!

Asteroids look weird bouncing inside the walls, they should float through it and away I think. Like the wavey walls. The wave chasing me is too slow, now pressure from it. It's a bit weird that I can turn on a dime now. Maybe it's more fun, but it seems thematically weird. Maybe I should have some momentum too, still faster handling than the chasers but not instant.
I need to be better.
SO CLOSE!

Controls are no difference in practice. I'm thinking let's try classic relative-turns-plus-throttle, with a decent level of inertia when I release the throttle. Didn't see enough chasers, which are the most fun part I feel. Too many asteroids that probably killed them off to early. Whe should experiement with fewer asteroids that vary more in size.
Came to a wall of asteroids, it was actually fun. I could have done better. I hesitated.

Didn't see any chasers, which was a bit lame. The laser was fun though, and hard. Can still be better. if we nail the controls and the intensity of chasers, and the asteroid behaviors. But overall I think this is the format, we'll see.
I do not apprecciate the death way lunging forward like that.
Actually, maybe I will miss this level of control if we go thrusters. Would need to try it. But I think we should either go back to no momentum at all, or go full thrusters.
Haha wow that's hard. Trying again.
Man, this is so much harder. But the satisfaction when I tricked three of them was high!
Haha ok I see what I have to do. This challenges me. I'll try again.
Loved when I was able to outsmart a couple chasers. Asteroids felt way harder now than in previous versions. The small ones are too small I think, I want fewer and larger ones I believe.
It's really tough to outrun a single chaser. I should have gone for the asteroids, tried to but they never came and then I was caught. I still think it's a skill issue though, wanna try again.
I successfully lured away a chaser and then another one came from out of nowhere near the bottom of the screen and killed me. Felt bad.
Two deaths from the same cause, I never got free in between. I like the bigger announcements of enemies, I need to try again.
It's tough, I think I need to be more aggressive.

Well, it's really hard that they (chasers) spawn anywhere basically. Hard to keep a plan in the back pocket so to speak. Maybe they need a slightly bigger turn radius to compensate for my harder controls now with the thruster.
They are nasty. "I can't shake em"
I think I like these asteroids. WIll have to try again.
Haha I was not ready for that laser. Chasers kept me busy.
Haha I'm terrible. But seems fun that the chasers have worse controls now, Wanna try again!
I am terrible at flying near but not into rocks and the wall. Chasers seemed fun though!
Ok the waving wall seems pretty tough actually. I learned I can gain control by easing off the thruster, not sure if that's the most fun though. will try again.

I feel like it might be a bit to hard to fly near the rocks, not sure. I seem to die to them all the time. Btw I did notice the chasers coming from the front before, and it was mostly fun I think. Will have to play more.
Feel like I want to try the non-thruster version again tbh.

Well. It's fun to make chasers collide, would be even more fun if more than one could collide at once, maybe if each one collides with a little explosion radius like a mine! Now I lured three of them together but only two of them died.
Awesome control with the direct controls back. I feel like I could have done better.
I was too cocky. Like Luke. I'm starting to like this, but I would have done better if chasers exploded in this run I think.

Nooo the blast got me! Ok I'm thinking maybe their blast should not hurt me. A bit unfair perhaps but hey I'm the hero here. Loved maneouvering between chasers, dodging precisely and seeing them roar by.

Yeah. It's getting there for sure. Something might still be missing though, not sure. There is a bit of a lull when I see a chaser coming and I first try to find a rock, but ok now it's too close for a rock, then I need to shake it by a quick turn. But that is risky. So maybe it's not a lull but fun. But I'm thinking one more thing could somehow make it even more exciting. Not sure what thing though.

Haha I loved it when chain reactions took the chasers! Didn't love it as much when it got me... I was thinking early in the run that it was a bit easy because no chasers seemed to get through. But then I had to eat those words.
AAaaaa I should have done better!
Ok. That's tough. Feeling a bit sad right now because they got me good.
Wow, so much fun!
That's cool. I wanted to trigger the slowmo so I got a bit too greedy :-D But wow what fun to lure 5 or 6 at once and see the chain effects!
Soo close! I'm getting good at this!

When more rocks appear, it's easier actually because the chasers kind of auto-die. Interesting. Maybe there are too many rocks. There could be more lasers in the end. I'm also thinking about what the meta loop should be like now, because this seems like a basically complete core loop to me. Luring them and getting the slow-mo as a reward as well as a little breather is awesome.
Fun! I was thinking that the "Rammers" or whatever those other enemy types are, they are basically just a waste of space. Remove them.
A bit too easy maybe, but it could be that I'm a master now. I basically love it now, and can't wait to make it infinitely replayable somehow.
Too Hard maybe, let's try again
Lagging on my phone. Also controls have a built in inertia on phone, i think the joystick radius might be too large.
Fun even though laggy.
